cc:Work.dc:title: G2 · boss outcomes and entry HP (descriptive; no margins)
cc:Work.dc:description: fresh_start_v1 · greedy full-game DEV evaluation, 4,096 paired worlds per contrast; 95% WORLD bootstrap CIs from strict comparisons. S = student; C = champion. Marginal reach/pass use all cohort worlds. Conditional pass and entry HP use each arm's reached worlds. Reach cohorts depend on policy: conditional contrasts are descriptive, not causal. No NI margin for boss rates or HP. ◇ = degenerate empirical bootstrap (constant observed contrast); it does not imply zero population uncertainty.

g.text: G2 · boss outcomes and entry HP (descriptive; no margins)
fresh_start_v1 · greedy full-game DEV evaluation, 4,096 paired worlds per contrast; 95% WORLD bootstrap CIs from strict comparisons.
S = student; C = champion. Marginal reach/pass use all cohort worlds. Conditional pass and entry HP use each arm's reached worlds.
Reach cohorts depend on policy: conditional contrasts are descriptive, not causal. No NI margin for boss rates or HP.
◇ = degenerate empirical bootstrap (constant observed contrast); it does not imply zero population uncertainty.
